Following the loss of his [[Obi-Wan Kenobi's Eta-2 Actis-class interceptor|previous]] [[Eta-2 Actis-class light interceptor|Eta-2]] during the [[Battle of Coruscant]], [[Jedi Master]] [[Obi-Wan Kenobi]] [[pilot]]ed a [[Color|blue]] '''Eta-2 ''Actis''-class light interceptor''' prior to the [[Battle of Utapau]].<ref name="RotS" />

==History==
After discovering that General Grievous was hiding on Utapau, the [[Jedi High Council]] requested for Master [[Obi-Wan Kenobi]] to hunt down the general. Having lost his [[Obi-Wan Kenobi's Eta-2 Actis-class interceptor|red Eta-2 ''Actis''-class light interceptor]] and his [[astromech droid]] [[R4-P17]] during the [[Battle of Coruscant]], Obi-Wan acquired a brand new blue Eta-2 for the mission, along with a new astromech droid, [[R4-G9]]. Kenobi decided he would head to the planet first to keep Grievous distracted until Clone [[Cody|Commander Cody]] and [[212th Attack Battalion|the 212 Attack Battalion]] arrived on the ''[[Vigilance (Venator-class)|Vigilance]]''. Kenobi docked his starfighter with a [[Syliure-45 hyperdrive module]] and entered [[hyperspace]] on course for Utapau.<ref name="RotS" />

[[File:R4-G9_Kenobi.png|thumb|left|300px|Kenobi and R4-G9]]
Upon arriving at [[Pau City]], Kenobi requested some fuel for his starfighter from [[Port Administrator|port administrator]] [[Tion Medon]]. After learning that Grievous was indeed on Utapau, Kenobi told R4 to take the starfighter back to the ''Vigilance'' and tell Cody that he had engaged the general. Kenobi watched as R4 and his starfighter left the planet. Kenobi would later use Grievous's [[Belbullab-22 heavy starfighter]], ''[[Soulless One]]'', to escape the planet after narrowly surviving [[Order 66]].<ref name="RotS" />

==Crew==
The starfighter was piloted by [[Obi-Wan Kenobi]], who also functioned as its captain. Kenobi's new [[astromech droid]] [[R4-G9]] functioned as the ship's navigator and repairer should it get damaged in combat.<ref name="RotS" />

{{Ship-stub}}

==Behind the scenes==
Obi-Wan Kenobi's blue Eta-2 ''Actis''-class light interceptor's first and only appearance was in ''[[Star Wars: Episode III Revenge of the Sith]]''.<ref name="RotS" />
